application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief
application.note: Second-life modules from VW Passat cars in grid-tied containers (maintainer, 2026-10-13: grid-scale storage, noted as second-life).

chemistry.note: Neither the release nor its paper or record states the cell chemistry.

units_released.note: Rule: one distinct second-life module id (88); the record's 106 are installation rows, some modules installed twice. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: 88 distinct modules x 12 cells in series (cells_in_series in the release's module-info tables)

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Cell files hold per-cell voltages for the modules reporting in each window; counting distinct cell channels needs a pass over the 12 windows.

energy_mwh.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17287096, module-info tables (nominal_energy_conversion, the VW Passat GTE pack rating, 9.9 or 13.0 kWh) / 8 modules per pack
energy_mwh.note: 88 distinct modules: 72 from 9.9 kWh packs and 16 from 13.0 kWh packs, each pack rating divided by 8 modules per pack (maintainer, 2026-10-13). Not computable from the data (no SOC signal).

span_unit_years.note: unit is the distinct module id (88); the record's 106 are installation rows, and 24 positions report at a time; unit-years is each installation's start to end date from the module-info tables, clipped to the data period 2023-04-20 to 2024-11-04, summed; telemetry covers only the 11 export windows, and three exports are truncated

obs_hours.note: Calendar spans are measurable, so observation-hours are not used.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17287096; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
